object_description: single wave-like building of organic outline with three round courtyards around a central atrium
design_condition: one wave-like building responds to the heterogeneous urban situation, its modulations creating a town square towards the city, a smaller neighbourhood square at the rear and a private hillside garden

positive: The project responds to the heterogeneous urban situation with a single building
A wave-like design creates different urban situations with different qualities
A greater expansion towards the city forms a town square connected to the old town by an underpass
Tree groups, furniture and a noise-dampening fountain provide a pleasant stay
A slightly smaller expansion at the rear forms the neighbourhood square
Seating steps, a fountain and a tree island lead to the villa garden area
The hillside garden offers a more private green space
The building appears to be shaped by the existing urban spaces
The connection to the city is surprisingly easy in section with good access to the various levels
The amorphous spaces in front of the building integrate the different access routes
Three round courtyards are grouped on different levels around a central atrium
Teaching and office rooms of different sizes occupy the edge, achieving good flexibility
Flexibility of use and the desired spatial relationships are implemented very well
The connection between research and teaching horizontally and vertically is quite possible
The lush traffic areas offer a clearly recognisable spatial reference supporting exchange
The central atrium penetrates all levels and works horizontally and vertically, easing orientation
The distribution of use meets the requirements for flexibility and allocation
Most operational processes are efficient and the density of use is appropriate
The fifth facade is designed as a green terrace integrating into the green surroundings
A very large-scale work making a logical offer for flexibility and internal networking
negative: The overall volume shows a clear jump in scale, particularly visible in the ground plan
The very uniform facade further supports this jump
The modulation cannot hide that the building brings a new standard to the district
The church is consequently demolished and the building takes almost the entire property
The lush traffic areas cannot be used convincingly in all areas
Daylight harvesting inside the building may be a bit difficult
The green roof terrace is strongly dominated by photovoltaic systems
The all-round identical slatted facade makes the building appear very uniform
It cannot fulfil its promise of responding differently to the various urban situations
The very large spans lead to a complex static system
The project is in the last third for sustainability and economic viability
The form requires a somewhat undirected, technical access system
The interests of the city as a growing organism take a back seat in some places
